#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   --job-name=br5_FPointNet
#   --partition=gpu
#   --mem=16G
#   --ntasks-per-node=32
#   --time=0-72:00:00
#   --output=/home/jbandl2s/train.%j.out
#   --error=/home/jbandl2s/train.%j.err
#   --gres=gpu:0

#flux: --job-name=br5_FPointNet
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 32
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=72h

# Omitted Slurm option: --mem=16G
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: job may be scheduled on a node with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or degraded performance.

# Omitted Slurm option: --partition=gpu
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run with different limits/priority or on different hardware (or be rejected by policy).

# Slurm GPU request: --gres=gpu:0 requests ZERO GPUs.
# No Flux GPU request is needed.
# Performance implication: none.

# Omitted Slurm options: --output/--error with %j token
# Slurm's %j token (job id) is not portable in Flux output/error directives.
# Performance implication: none, but logs may overwrite/collide unless you choose unique filenames.

module load cuda

source ~/anaconda3/bin/activate ~/anaconda3/envs/3DOD_Env

cd /home/jbandl2s/sub_ensembles/models

DATA_FILE="/scratch/jbandl2s/Lyft_dataset/artifacts/frustums_train"
MODEL_LOG_DIR="./log_v1_test/"
RESTORE_MODEL_PATH="./log_v1_test/model.ckpt"

# Slurm requested 32 tasks; preserve by launching under Flux.
flux run -n 32 -c 1 python train_branch_15.py

reasons: The original Slurm job requested 16G of memory (`--mem=16G`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; on systems that schedule/enforce memory this can under-provision the job and risk OOM or degraded performance.

The original Slurm job specified a partition (`--partition=gpu`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/partition selection; on sites where this affects eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.

#SBATCH --time=0-72:00:00           # HH-MM-SS
#SBATCH --output=/home/jbandl2s/train.%j.out # filename for STDOUT (%N: nodename, %j: j$
#SBATCH --error=/home/jbandl2s/train.%j.err  # filename for STDERR

# load cuda
module load cuda

# activate environment
source ~/anaconda3/bin/activate ~/anaconda3/envs/3DOD_Env

# locate to your root directory

# run the script
